confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Meal and hostel anchors are moderately certain. Draught beer (draught is less common than bottled beer in Kathmandu) and the 3-star hotel tier are least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the beer anchor at about 1.8x and 1.7x because direct price knowledge is weak; wine is further affected by import duties. July is monsoon low season, so hotel rates may run below peak levels. FX value came from search results restricted to rba.gov.au; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is South Asia, referenced to Kathmandu's tourist districts (Thamel, Lazimpat) and general knowledge of other Nepali and northern Indian tourist cities. USD values were estimated directly from approximate local price levels, not from a sourced exchange rate.
